title: Twin Fates
next_chapter_hook: When two identical faces confront each other beyond the sect's gates, the secret of the Tianji Record is about to face its most violent upheaval— who is the true Chess Player of this game?

text.content: Dusk descended like ink, shrouding the Tianqing Sect Mountain Gate. I stood with hands clasped behind my back at the edge of the Martial Arena, my robes fluttering violently in the mountain wind, yet my gaze remained fixedly locked on the figure slowly approaching from dozens of zhang away. Though his aura was utterly distinct, though he felt like a stranger approaching the brink of nonexistence, that face—that damned face—matched my reflection in the bronze mirror without a single discrepancy. It seemed as if Heaven, at some indescribable moment, had peeled away my shadow and reshaped it into this uninvited guest. The fragment in my chest suddenly blazed with scorching heat, as if sensing something. My pupils constricted, and alarm bells rang in my heart: this person was no coincidental passerby.

dialogue.content: 「Chen Ji... or should I address you as 'the Vessel'?」 The man stopped three zhang away, a knowing smile playing at the corners of his lips. His low, clear voice cut through the night wind: 「Do you know that you are merely a vessel to contain the Tianji Record?」

text.content: Vessel? Vessel? Those two words pierced my heart like ice daggers, yet strangely failed to ignite even a flicker of emotion. I lowered my eyes, concealing the tumultuous waves in my gaze, leaving only a hint of mockery dancing on the corner of my lips. Years of intricate scheming and countless dances on the edge of a blade had long taught me one crucial lesson: the more unbelievable the truth, the more calmly it must be chewed. This person clearly harbored malicious intentions, but since he dared to reveal his true face, he must possess some trump card. I slowly raised my eyes, meeting those identical ones staring back, my tonecalm得近乎cold: 「Your disguise is quite meticulously crafted. Which old acquaintance sent you as this performer?」

dialogue.content: 「A performer?」 The man laughed lightly, but the smile didn't reach his eyes. 「The legitimate Chen family bloodline, the true host of the complete Tianji Record—Chen Nian's older brother, the former patriarch's legitimate eldest son. Do even a fragment of these memories remain in your defective recollection?」

text.content: Chen Nian. Chen family. Legitimate eldest son. Those three words struck like three heavy hammers, creating cracks in the framework of comprehension I had so carefully constructed over the years. The matter of my sister Chen Nian being abducted by the Holy Sect—I had never revealed a single word of this to anyone. I wasn't even certain if my memories had been tampered with. Yet this person spoke her name as casually as discussing the weather. The fragment in my chest blazed more intensely, seemingly responding to some summoning or perhaps issuing a warning. I drew a deep breath, pressing all surging thoughts into the abyss, my expression unchanged as I casually raised a faint smile: 「Deliberately confusing. If you truly are Chen family blood, why hide and conceal? I've played this worthless persona for years. Let's see how much more skilled you are compared to that fool Han Lie.」

choice.prompt: Facing the self-proclaimed legitimate Chen family heir's provocation, you choose...

choices.description: Retreat to advance, extracting more intelligence about the Chen family and Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: The enemy may use this to decipher your true strength

text.content: I收敛气息，故作amused地打量着他：「Chen family legitimate heir? Interesting. My 'sister' never mentioned having a brother—unless, you are the mastermind behind her abduction?」 As I spoke, I fixed my gaze on his pupils, not missing any trace of emotional fluctuation. The fragment within me warmed slightly—that was my Foresight Ability stirring. I forcibly suppressed it. Heavenly Fate Value cannot be casually squandered on such unverified speculation.

dialogue.content: 「Sister?」 The man's brow creased, a complex emotion flickering in his eyes. 「Chen Nian... she's actually alive? It seems the Holy Sect kept their word.」 He paused, his tone suddenly turning cold. 「But the child of destiny you believe yourself to be—that is merely an eighteen-year deception.」

choices.description: Directly pressure with momentum, forcing the enemy to reveal their weaknesses
choices.visible_reward: Gauge the enemy's depth of strength
choices.risk_hint: If the enemy's strength far exceeds expectations, may fall into a passive position

text.content: I，不再废话。Mydantiantrue qi erupted thunderously, transforming into a piercing pressure that crashed toward my opponent's face. This force was precisely calibrated—powerful enough to狼狈 him, yet restrained enough to avoid a fatal blow, preserving room for observation. The night wind froze abruptly, and the blue stone floor of the Martial Arena emitted tiny cracking sounds from the residual force. I locked my gaze onto that face identical to mine, while my mind rapidly calculated: this person dares to come alone, either because he has some hidden advantage, or—in other words—simply deems a sneak attack beneath him.

dialogue.content: When faced with an attack sufficient to shock ordinary Golden Core stage cultivators, the individual merely raised his hand and spread his five fingers. An intangible force rushed forward like a tidal wave, completely deflecting my imposing pressure! He strode forward, each step landing precisely in the gaps of my momentum, completely disregarding me. 「Is that all? Chen Ji, do you truly believe you can control the Tianji Record with such insignificant skills?」

choices.description: Pretend to be moved, observe how the enemy intends to set their net
choices.visible_cost: Must endure the enemy's mental suppression
choices.visible_reward: Force the opponent to reveal more of their hidden cards
choices.process_label: show weakness to lure them in

text.content: I lowered my gaze, letting the sharp light in my eyes gradually dim, as if my mind had been shattered by this cascade of truths. My shoulders slumped slightly, my lips parted a few times, yet no words came—perfectly timed dejection. This act I had performed for over a decade, already mastered with ease. Yet deep within, my heart turned to ice: Who is this person? Why do they know all my secrets so thoroughly? The Chen Nian matter, the secret of the Tianji Record, the 'deception' in their words... every clue pointed toward some abyss I had yet to reach.

dialogue.content: "What, scared?" The mockery in his eyes intensified. "Understandable, I suppose. Eighteen years of chess, and you're merely a piece pushed onto the board. Now that the true master has returned, this useless piece should make way." He stretched out his hand, pointing at the scalding spot on my chest. "The Tianji Record Fragment was always meant to be mine. Hand it over, and perhaps I'll let you die with some dignity."

text.content: "Useless piece? Make way? Die with dignity?" These words from his lips did not provoke my anger; instead, they stirred an inexplicable thrill deep within my heart. How many years? How many years since anyone dared humiliate me so openly to my face? That fool Han Lie at least knew to bring a gang of thugs. This person, venturing alone to the Tianqing Sect Mountain Gate, dares to spew such arrogant words. I slowly straightened the spine I had deliberately curved, the curve of my lips deepening, and that faint smile began to carry genuine edge. The fragment remained scalding against my chest, yet I distinctly felt its connection to my soul becoming closer than ever—as if responding to some choice forming in the depths of my heart.

dialogue.content: "Interesting." At my reaction, he showed no anger but instead a playful smile. "This 'vessel' is more composed than I anticipated. But it doesn't matter—" He suddenly raised his hand, and a light appeared in his palm, identical to the one emanating from my chest fragment. "That fragment of yours is merely a shard torn violently from the true Tianji Record. And I here... possess another piece."

text.content: The moment that radiance appeared, the fragment on my chest shuddered violently—akin to reunited lovers, or evenly matched nemeses. A tearing pain spread from my heart through every limb, an involuntary groan escaping my lips as cold sweat beaded at my temples. Yet simultaneously, an unprecedented clarity exploded within my mind—those information fragments from the fragment flashed through my consciousness like a carousel: stars falling from the heavens, countless eyes gazing down from endless darkness, and a vague yet deafening whisper—"Twinborn calamity, fates intertwining, the chess player shall ultimately reap what they sow." I bit down hard on my back teeth, forcing the metallic taste rising in my throat back down. This was not prophecy—this was memory! Memory sealed deep within my bloodline!

choice.prompt: The Tianji Record Fragment resonates intensely, you feel sealed memory fragments surge within your heart. At this moment, you choose...

choices.description: Consume Heavenly Fate to activate Foresight Ability, attempting to perceive the full picture of both fates intertwining
choices.visible_reward: Obtain key prophecy about the twinborn
choices.risk_hint: If the other party can perceive your ability consumption, they may strike at your weakness

text.content: I closed my eyes, allowing that tearing force to rage within my body. Recklessly, I summoned the predictive power remaining in the fragment, letting it drag me into the vortex of destiny. Heavenly Fate drained away like flowing water, yet my vision gradually clarified—three intertwined fates emerged in the void: one mine, one his, and one... an existence I could not identify. And at the end of those three trajectories, an eye composed of countless runes gazed down coldly at all this. The Eye of Heavenly Dao! My heart quaked violently, almost causing me to cry out—so the so-called twinborn struggle was merely a single move in a grander chess game!

dialogue.content: "You saw it?" His voice rang through my mental chaos, carrying an indescribable nuance. "You think defying fate means anything? You're merely dancing on a stage others have already designed. And I—" his voice suddenly rose, "will overturn this entire game!"

choices.description: Use fragment resonance to counterattack the other party, attempting to disrupt their mental state
choices.risk_hint: If the opponent is prepared, it may backfire

text.content: Since the fragments could resonate, I would follow that connection and infuse my own will into it. I drew a deep breath, my consciousness shaping into an invisible blade, riding the fragment's tremor to surge directly into his Mental Sea—not seeking to harm, merely to scatter his concentration for a moment. This was a devious technique I had learned from a Demonic Path secret manual years ago, using spiritual consciousness to counter spiritual consciousness—injuring a thousand while costing oneself eight hundred. But at this moment, I could not afford to worry about that.

dialogue.content: He clearly did not anticipate my move. His body stiffened slightly, a flicker of pain crossing his features, yet the next moment he recovered, his smile turning even more sinister. "Petty tricks, dare to show off before an expert?" His five fingers clenched abruptly, and the light resonating with my fragment suddenly surged, transforming into an invisible chain that bound my four limbs. "Since you insist on being a chess piece, don't blame me—being impolite."

choices.description: Feign weakness, pull back to create distance, re-evaluate the situation
choices.visible_reward: Preserve your strength, seek out the flaws
choices.risk_hint: The opponent may press the advantage and not give us a moment to breathe

text.content: I didn't face it head-on. The tremor of the fragment perfectly helped me deflect the force, my body drifting backward like autumn leaves in the wind for several zhang, seemingly embarrassed, yet every step was precise, landing in the gaps of his assault. The man frowned, clearly not expecting me to maintain such composed judgment in this situation. I steadied myself, brushed the blood from my lips with my sleeve, my gaze growing deeper: 'You do have some skill, fellow. However—' I shifted my tone, 'since you want to overturn this chess game, why waste words with me? Unless... you need me too.'

dialogue.content: The man froze for an instant, then burst into laughter: 'Interesting! Indeed, one who could make the Tianji Record acknowledge a master—even if only a fragment.' He withdrew his assault, standing with hands behind his back, 'Indeed, I need you. Without this fragment, the piece I hold becomes rootless duckweed, forever unable to glimpse the complete Heavenly Secrets. So, Chen Ji—' his burning gaze fixed on me, 'how about you and I cooperate?'

text.content: Cooperate? These two words from his lips were wrapped in honey but concealed bone-scraping daggers within. I gazed downward in contemplation, my expression unchanged, while my mind raced at lightning speed: this man knows of Chen Nian, knows the secrets of the Tianji Record, and even knows a corner of my years-long scheme—if he were truly an enemy, why not strike directly? From the strength he just displayed, he could have subdued me before I could react. But he didn't. He chose the most indirect method: revealing truths, attempting to persuade. What does this mean? It means there is something he wants from me that he cannot forcibly take. I raised my eyes, precisely meeting those eyes identical to mine, suddenly recalling the prophecy transmitted by the fragment—'Twin catastrophe, destinies intersect.' Twin... so that's it. Not an enemy, nor a simple ally, but a far more complex, far more intertwined community of fate.

dialogue.content: 'You and I were one body with two souls in our mother's womb,' he seemed to see through my confusion, his voice low and almost murmuring, 'The Tianji Record was torn into two pieces, each of us holding one. Eighteen years ago, someone separated us, casting you into this desolate backwater, letting you survive amid humiliation and trampling; while I was raised in the shadows, honed under the name of 'legitimacy.' Their purpose was simple—to make us slaughter each other, completing the Tianji Record through killing, and then... offering it to the Heavenly Eye.'

text.content: Heavenly Eye. These four words doused me like a basin of ice water, extinguishing every last trace of my lingering hope. I had always thought my opponents were the three great sects, the demonic path invasion, or Old Sect Master Ling Yuan and others lurking in darkness. But it turns out, from beginning to end, I was merely an ant in the eyes of some higher being, self-righteously struggling along the orbit it had drawn. Anger? Despair? These emotions surged in my heart for an instant before I forcibly crushed them. Remembering grudges without being rash—this was my greatest reliance for surviving to this day. I slowly raised my head, facing those eyes connected to me by blood yet utterly unfamiliar, a meaningful smile curving my lips: 'So what? You tell me all this, expecting me to obediently hand over the fragment and help accomplish your grand scheme?'

choice.prompt: After the truth was revealed, your response was...

choices.description: Never accept a fate arranged by others, even if the other party is a blood relative
choices.risk_hint: The power of twin bloodlines merging will put you at absolute disadvantage

text.content: 'In this life, I Chen Ji despise being used as a chess piece the most.' I spoke word by word, my voice cold enough to freeze ice, 'Whether you're the Heavenly Eye or destiny itself, if you want to use me as a blade, first ask if you're qualified!' The words fell, the fragment erupted with brilliant light, resonating with the piece in his hand, yet no longer passive—it was my active declaration of war!

dialogue.content: The man froze for an instant, then revealed a complex smile: 'As expected... we're the same, both lunatics who refuse to submit. Very well, since it's like this—' his form began gradually dissolving, leaving only final words echoing in the night wind, 'Next volume, meet in the Tianji Secret Realm.届时, either you die or I do.'

choices.description: Pretend to agree to cooperation, secretly arrange to also take this chess piece into my own game
choices.visible_cost: Need to constantly guard against the other party's counterattack
choices.visible_reward: Gain key intelligence about the Heavenly Eye
choices.risk_hint: If exposed, will completely enrage the other party

text.content: I didn't answer immediately. Silence spread through the night wind for several breaths before I slowly spoke, my tone carrying appropriate deliberation: 'Cooperation... is not impossible. But I have conditions.' I raised my eyes, staring directly at him, 'Chen Nian—I want to know her whereabouts. And—all intelligence about the Heavenly Eye. In exchange, the fragment can be temporarily lent to you, but you must swear a soul oath.' These words were watertight, expressing cooperation while not abandoning any bottom line.

dialogue.content: The man gazed at me deeply, a flash of admiration crossing his eyes: 'You're more difficult to deal with than I imagined. Very well, I agree.' He waved his hand, a pitch-black token flying toward me, 'With this token, you may enter the Tianji Secret Realm. Chen Nian... she is in the depths of the Holy Sect, used as a sacrifice to awaken the Heavenly Eye. As for more—' he paused meaningfully, 'wait until we meet again.'

choices.description: Propose conditions the other party cannot refuse, thoroughly seize the initiative
choices.visible_cost: Need to expose part of your trump cards as bait
choices.visible_reward: Leave the opponent constantly on the defensive in the chess game ahead.
choices.risk_hint: If the terms are too generous, it might arouse suspicion in the other party.

text.content: I suddenly let out a light laugh, and that laughter sounded particularly突兀 in the silent night: "You say that each of us holds a fragment, indispensable to the other. Since that's the case——" I turned the conversation sharply, my gaze suddenly fierce, "then why can't I be the chess player, and you be the chess piece?" I raised my hand, the fragment's glow turning into a thin thread that wound around his wrist, "What the Heavenly Eye wants is the complete Tianji Record, not any individual's loyalty. Between you and me, rather than fighting to the death——" I leaned closer, my voice dropping to a whisper only the two of us could hear, "let's take its place."

dialogue.content: His pupils constricted sharply, and for the first time, genuine shock appeared on his face. After a long while, he let out a deep breath, his gaze toward me carrying more complex and unidentifiable emotions: "You're insane." "No," I stepped back, resuming my hands-behind-back stance, yet my smile grew even deeper, "I'm insane——insane for eighteen years. A madman who struggled to survive in the garbage dump understands best what it means to find life from certain death. You want cooperation? Fine. But the one leading this cooperation... can only be me."

text.content: He left. Taking that pitch-black token and a body full of mysteries, vanishing into the night's depths as if he'd never appeared. But I knew, everything had changed. That figure identical to me, that terrifying truth about the twins, that Heavenly Eye coldly watching from the depths of fate——all of it, like blunt knives, peeling away layer by layer the disguise I'd carefully crafted for years. I stood in the center of the Martial Arena, letting the night wind ruffle my temples, the fragment against my chest gradually calming, yet burning hotter than ever before. The Tianji Record... so from the very beginning, I was merely a chess piece in a much larger game. And now, not only do I want to be the chess player——I want to overturn this entire chessboard.

dialogue.content: "Do you see it?" An aged yet familiar voice rang out in my mind. It was Mr. Mo, dormant within the fragment: "This is the truth you've been pursuing——the other half of the Tianji Record, and the destiny of the Chen twins." His tone was uncharacteristically heavy, "However, he didn't tell you everything. For instance... why were you separated? Why was Chen Nian taken by the Holy Sect? And——" He paused, "why did the Tianji Record choose you, and not him?"

text.content: I closed my eyes, letting Mr. Mo's words reverberate through my consciousness. Why choose me? I'd asked this question countless times, the fragment never answering. But tonight, when that face identical to mine appeared before my eyes, some vague intuition told me——the answer lies within those falling stars, in the Heavenly Eye's cold gaze overlooking all living beings. I took a deep breath, pressing all my chaotic thoughts into the depths of my heart. When I opened my eyes, they held a cool, resolute certainty. No matter the truth, no matter how many conspiracies and schemes awaited ahead——my fate, Chen Ji's fate, has always been in my own hands. The Tianji Record, the twins, the Heavenly Eye... all shall be thus.

dialogue.content: "Mr. Mo," I suddenly spoke, my voice calm to the point of coldness, "What is the core objective of the next scroll?" The fragment warmed slightly as an information stream flooded my mind——"Find Chen Nian, uncover the connection between the Holy Sect and the Heavenly Eye, and reclaim the initiative within the Tianji Secret Realm." A dangerous curve formed at the corner of my lips. The show... is only just beginning.

text.content: The eastern horizon turned pearly white, a new day about to arrive. I turned and walked toward the sect, my spine straight as if that thrilling confrontation had been nothing but a trivial interlude. Yet in an angle no one could see, my fingertips trembled slightly——that was the weakness after massive consumption of Heavenly Fate, and also the rage and unwillingness suppressed for too long. Trash persona? Container? Chess piece? These labels had been stuck on me for so long, I'd almost forgotten what kind of scorching heart of defiance lay beneath thetrash shell. Now, it's time to let the entire world see clearly——who is the true chess player of this chaotic era. In the distance, Tianqing Sect's morning bells rang softly, and I, Chen Ji, shall on fate's chessboard, move my piece without regret.
